title: Sign up for an Online Services (myRTA.com) account
summary: Learn how to set up an Online Services (myRTA.com) account to access various online services provided by Transport for NSW.
intro:
myRTA.com is where you access some online services provided by Transport for NSW.

Services include:
who_can_apply: Must have a NSW Driver Licence or Photo Card.
Must have a vehicle registered in your name (unless calling 13 22 13 to complete set-up).
what_you_need: NSW Driver Licence or NSW Photo Card details

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to sign up for an account.

more_info.text: An Online Services account is different to a MyServiceNSW Account.

external_links.text: All about account set-up with Online Services

internal_links.text: booking or managing licensing and driving tests

faqs.q: What services can I access with an Online Services account?
faqs.a: myRTA.com provides access to various online services from Transport for NSW.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to set up an Online Services account online?
faqs.a: You must have a NSW Driver Licence or Photo Card, and a vehicle registered in your name.

faqs.q: What should I do if I don't have a vehicle registered in my name?
faqs.a: If you do not have a vehicle registered in your name, you can still set up an Online Services account, but you must call 13 22 13 to complete the set-up.
